ns0:entry.ns0:title: Large Performance Fixes
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
This release brings large performance fixes across Unsloth: faster typing and search in long chats, faster image/video loads, two-GPU image/video gen. It also adds separate browsers for each chat, floating browser window.

Highlights

  • Large performance fixes with more Glass theme optimizations coming next week
  • Glass theme fixes no m

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Improved Customization + Glass + Browser Use
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
This release introduces Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Dynamic V3.1, polishes the Glass themes (now in Beta), adds a Composer position slider and lets models interact with files in the built-in browser. It also brings lower idle memory usage, preserved chat context when switching GGUF models, faster MLX loading and FP8 LoRA training.

Highlights

  • Qwen3.8-Flash-N

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Glass Theme, Personalize & Faster Generation
ns0:entry.ns0:content: Unsloth now has Glass themes and more customization options for backgrounds, greetings and chats. This release also brings faster generation, more multi-GPU training options and CPU training in Unsloth.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Customize + Performance + UI/UX improvements
ns0:entry.ns0:content: Make Unsloth your own with custom backgrounds and a improved UI/UX. This release also cuts app update times and speeds up Linux app and Qwen-Image gen when VRAM is limited. Also new: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 in Unsloth Dynamic v3.1 GGUFs (preview), FLUX.2-klein-9B on low-RAM machines, smoother chats and batched MoE

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Trick or Treat + Optimizations
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Halloween 👻 is here. Through October, a Trick or treat row in the sidebar opens eleven Halloween themes, spooky greetings and a few spiders and bats.

This release also speeds up the first launch, Linux tool calls and model loading, and trains compatible fine-tuning jobs together with multi-LoRA.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Scheduled + MiniMax-M3.1-Flash + Perf Gains
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
This release adds scheduled tasks, FLUX-3 edit support, perf improvements and more. Also new: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, face touch-ups for images and faster performance + chats on Mac.

Highlights

  • Scheduled tasks: Run a prompt on a schedule with a local model or an API
  • MiniMax-M3.1-Flash: MiniMax's 428B MoE (23B active)

ns0:entry.ns0:title: MOSS-Image, Flint & NVIDIA Bolt E4B
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Recursive's Flint, MOSS-Image and NVIDIA's Nemotron Bolt 4B are here! Run them locally in Unsloth. Also new: a chat-only Unsloth Desktop install, MLX MoE models bigger than your Mac's memory and an OpenAI-compatible fine-tuning API.

Highlights

  • Bigger MoE models on Mac: MLX MoE models too big for memory keep experts on SSD, so Qwen3.8-Flash-Next runs on a 3

ns0:entry.ns0:title: DeepSeek-V4.1 & FLUX-3
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and FLUX.3 Image Klein are here! Run both locally in Unsloth. Also new: images and videos in chat, multi-GPU training with FSDP2 (alpha) and one-command MCP setup for coding agents.

Highlights

  • DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017: 552B (16B active) - runs on ~125 GB at 1-bit with its Engram table on SSD

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Meta Muse Spark Open + NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Run NVIDIA's new Nemotron 3.5 models and Meta's new Muse Spark Open locally in Unsloth. New: text-diffusion LLMs, DeepSpeed training and better prompt caching for coding agents.

Highlights

  • NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt: Run on 24 GB of memory. Guide
  • NVIDIA Nemotron 3.
